data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'tese,' meaning 'to reap.' In Christian tradition, Tessie symbolizes the blessing of God's harvest and the fruitfulness of His blessings. The name Tessie carries the meaning “God's Harvest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tessie usually hope their child will grow to embody god's harvest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
